spans.s:
नैरञ्जना नैरञ्जना, f. (fr. निर्-अञ्जन), N.
of a river falling into the Gaṅgā in Magadha (now
called Niladyan).

नैरन्तर्य नैरन्तर्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-अन्तर),
absence of interruption or interval, uninterruptedness,
close succession, continuousness, contiguity, closeness,
compactness; (एण), ind. without interval or inter-
ruption, constantly, incessantly, uninterruptedly.

नैरपेक्ष्य नैरपेक्ष्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-
अपेक्ष), disregard, indifference.

नैरयिक नैरयिक, अस्, m. (fr. निर्-अय), an
inhabitant of hell.

नैरर्थ्य नैरर्थ्य, अम्, n. meaninglessness,
senselessness, nonsense.

नैराश्य नैराश्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-आश),
hopelessness, despair; the absence of wish or expect-
ation, non-expectancy.

नैरास्य नैरास्य, अस्, m. (fr. निर्-आस), N.
of a magical formula pronounced over weapons.

नैरुक्त नैरुक्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निर्-उक्त),
relating to the Nirukta (q. v.), explaining it; resting
on etymology, explained etymologically; (अस्), m.
one who knows the etymology or true derivation
of words.

नैरुक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who knows the
etymology or radical meaning of words, an etymo-
logist.
नैरुज्य नैरुज्य, अम्, n. (fr. नी-रुज), health.

नैरूहिक नैरूहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. निर्-
ऊह), purging, cleaning out.

नैरृत नैरृत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निर्-ऋति), be-
longing &c. to Nir-ṛti; south-western; belonging to
the Rākṣasas; relating to the lunar mansion Nairṛta
(Mūla); (अस्), m., N. of the ruler of the south-west
quarter; a child or offspring of Nir-ṛti, a demon,
imp, goblin, Rākṣasa; N. of a Rudra; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people; (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā; (with
[]
or without दिश्) the south-west quarter; (अम्), n.
the lunar mansion Mūla.
नैरृति, इस्, m., N. of a demon, a Rākṣasa.

नैरृतेय, अस्, ई, अम्, descended from Nir-ṛti,
belonging to or connected with Nir-ṛti.

नैरृत्य, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Nir-ṛti; south-
western; a sacrifice offered to Nir-ṛti.

नैर्गन्ध्य नैर्गन्ध्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-गन्-
ध), absence of smell or odour, inodorousness.

नैर्गुण्य नैर्गुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-गुण),
absence of qualities or properties; freedom from
qualities; want of excellencies; absence of good
qualities; (अस्, ई, अम्), having no connection with
qualities.

नैर्घृण्य नैर्घृण्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-घृण),
pitilessness, unmercifulness, cruelty.

नैर्दश्य नैर्दश्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-दश),
getting over the critical period of the first ten days
(of a new-born child), surmounting any dangerous
time or bad influence.

नैर्देशिक नैर्देशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, servant,
servile.

नैर्बाध्य नैर्बाध्य (fr. निर्-बाध), Ved.
(with हविस्) a sort of oblation.

नैर्मल्य नैर्मल्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-मल),
stainlessness, spotlessness (physical and moral), clean-
ness, purity.

नैर्लज्ज्य नैर्लज्ज्य, अम्, n. (fr. निर्-लज्ज),
shamelessness, impudence.

नैर्वाहिक नैर्वाहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निर्-
वाह), conducting or leading out, carrying (water
&c.) out; (with द्वार) a sluice.

नैर्हस्त नैर्हस्त (fr. निर्-हस्त), Ved. ‘in-
tended for handless demons,’ N. of a particular
magical missile weapon.
